summary: Maintainability of suit challenging CBI jurisdiction post withdrawal of DSPE Act consent; Article 131 (federal disputes) subject to other constitutional provisions including Article 136; no cause of action against Union as non-participant in CBI investigations; CBI's operational independence under CVC supervision; misjoinder/non-joinder of parties; factual foundation requirement; precedents on federal disputes (State of Bihar/Rajasthan v. Union of India); lis pendens with pending appeals.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946 s.6
final_judgment: Suit dismissed as not maintainable; Article 131 suit barred where subject matter pending under Articles 136/226; Union not appropriate party for CBI actions; no factual basis established.
